description: Methods called on instances typed as an interface: unbindable without types. Regression for a false negative found by running depwave on itself (commit ad5322f: GitError's message changed, cli.test.ts depended on it through GitService instance methods).

scenarios.name: error-reached-through-instance-method
scenarios.description: AppError is thrown from run(), called by Service.exec, reached only via an interface-typed instance. Using a class must mean depending on all of its members.

scenarios.name: private-helper-change
scenarios.description: run() changes: only the app (through the instance), not the error's own test.
